summary: Separate English discovery queries evidenced Blackpool Council's public planning-map and local-land-charges routes, and HM Land Registry's official INSPIRE index-polygon download route. The planning destination exposed only a generic ArcGIS shell, while the Blackpool HMLR download encountered a redirect loop. No safe anonymous parcel ID-plus-geometry response was obtained and no sample GeoJSON is retained.
queryAndRequestOutcomes: All executed discovery queries, actual result URLs, direct request outcomes, scope limits, safe field allowlist, and uncertainty are recorded in city-2537-blackpool.json. No login, CAPTCHA/Cloudflare bypass, credentials, private tokens, TLS bypass, or unsafe-field request occurred.

custodians.name: Blackpool Council
custodians.scope: Local planning-map and local-land-charges procedure custodian; public parcel geometry access was not qualified.

custodians.name: HM Land Registry
custodians.scope: National custodian of the open INSPIRE index-polygon dataset for England and Wales, with a Blackpool Borough Council download entry; not a Blackpool local API.
